WHAT IF YOUR JOINT PAIN ISN’T REALLY CAUSED BY AGE?

WATCH THE FULL PRESENTATION NOW

If your knees feel stiff when you wake up, stairs have become something you think twice about, or getting out of a chair isn’t as effortless as it used to be, you’ve probably heard the same explanation over and over: age, arthritis, and ordinary wear and tear.

But this presentation explores a very different theory. It reveals why the visible damage inside a joint may be only part of the story—and examines a hidden process that could help explain why cartilage, natural joint lubrication, and mobility can continue to decline even when you’re doing everything you were told to do.

You’ll also discover why researchers began looking at two completely different traditions thousands of miles apart—one in the mountains of Japan and another in India—and why combining those discoveries became the center of an unusual two-step approach to joint health.

If you’ve been told that stiffness, grinding joints, or “bone-on-bone” are simply things you have to accept as you get older, watch the full presentation before you accept that conclusion.
